tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Other than MSMEs Previous work orders and experience certificate should be uploaded for the similar supply the similar nature of equipment type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 6.95 Lakhs or 80% of the quantity required in at least one of the last three years 2022-23 to 2024-25 to any Central/State Govt. Organization/ULB and shall be in operating condition at the time of bidding. The equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. or For MSMEs Previous work orders and experience certificate should be uploaded for the similar supply to the Government Departments for an amount of 3.47 Lakhs /(40% of the requirement of the quantity) required in at least one of the last three years 2022-23 to 2024-25. MSEs Registration certificate should be uploaded. Or For manufacturer authorization Certificate should be Uploaded who must have Tested manufactured and Supplied up to at least 2.60 Lakhs or (30% of the required quantity) in at least one of the last three years 2022-23 to 2024-25

MSMEs -The Average Annual financial turnover of the tenderer should be not less than 4.34 Lakhs in any one year during the last 3 financial years(2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25) MSMEs registration certificate should be uploaded, Other than MSMEs -The Average Annual financial turnover of the tenderer should be not less than 8.68 Lakhs in any one year during the last 3 financial years(2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25) CA certified turnover certificate with UDIN should be uploaded
